goal: Present a concise research update on training deep learning models to distinguish polite, bitter, and true smiles, with emphasis on dataset status, limitations, and candidate model designs.

deck_context.source_summary: The project aims to use the existing smile dataset to train a model that distinguishes polite smiles, bitter smiles, and true smiles. A longer-term goal is to learn separate representation axes where pure smile types vary more linearly.
deck_context.core_claim: The current dataset can support baseline experimentation, but class imbalance and motion-related noise must be addressed before reliable smile-type representation learning.
